title: Long, round turns
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Pick a wide, gentle slope with room to travel.
Let each turn run its full arc before you start the next.
Stay relaxed and smooth: the humps should be wide and even.

callouts.text: Wide humps: the same shape as carving, just slower.
Long, smooth crossings: no rush at the switch.
Few turns in the same time: compare with the short-turns video.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
